# Jankx WooCommerce Layout System

Hệ thống quản lý layouts cho WooCommerce với kiến trúc mở rộng và hiệu năng cao.

## Kiến trúc tổng quan

Hệ thống sử dụng các Design Patterns chính:
- Registry Pattern: LayoutManager quản lý tất cả layouts
- Singleton Pattern: Managers (Layout, CSS, Settings) đều là singleton
- Template Method Pattern: Abstract classes định nghĩa skeleton, child override chi tiết
- Strategy Pattern: Layouts có thể swap dynamically

## Cấu trúc core

### Interfaces (Contracts/)
- LayoutInterface: Base interface cho tất cả layouts
- CssManagerInterface: Quản lý CSS compilation và injection
- LayoutManagerInterface: Registry cho layouts
- SettingsInterface: Quản lý settings cho layouts

### Layout-specific Interfaces (Contracts/Layouts/)
- ProductDetailLayoutInterface: Product detail pages
- ProductLoopLayoutInterface: Product listing/grid
- ProductCategoryBlockLayoutInterface: Category blocks
- ProductGalleryLayoutInterface: Product galleries
- CartFormLayoutInterface: Cart forms (mini cart, widget)
- CartPageLayoutInterface: Cart page
- CheckoutPageLayoutInterface: Checkout page
- QuickCheckoutLayoutInterface: Quick checkout (custom feature)

### Abstract Classes (Abstracts/)
- AbstractLayout: Base cho tất cả layouts, implement common logic
- AbstractCssManager: Base cho CSS managers
- Abstract layout classes (Abstracts/Layouts/): Một abstract cho mỗi layout type

### Core System (LayoutSystem/)
- LayoutManager: Registry quản lý layouts (Singleton)
- CssManager: Compile SCSS và inject inline CSS (Singleton)
- SettingsManager: Quản lý settings và generate dynamic CSS (Singleton)
- LayoutBootstrap: Bootstrap và khởi tạo hệ thống

### Concrete Layouts (Layouts/)
Mỗi loại có default layouts:
- ProductDetail/: DefaultProductDetailLayout
- ProductLoop/: GridProductLoopLayout, ListProductLoopLayout
- CategoryBlock/: GridCategoryBlockLayout
- Gallery/: SliderGalleryLayout
- Cart/: DefaultCartPageLayout
- Checkout/: DefaultCheckoutLayout, MultiStepCheckoutLayout
- QuickCheckout/: ModalQuickCheckoutLayout

## CSS Management Strategy

### Inline CSS Only (Core Web Vitals Optimization)
- Không dùng external CSS files
- CSS được inject trực tiếp vào HTML via <style> tag
- Mỗi layout có common CSS (compiled từ SCSS) và dynamic CSS (generated từ settings)

### SCSS Compilation
```php
// SCSS files tại: assets/scss/layouts/{type}/{layout-id}.scss
$cssManager = CssManager::getInstance();
$css = $cssManager->compile('/path/to/layout.scss');
```

### Dynamic CSS Generation
```php
// Child layouts override generateDynamicCss()
protected function generateDynamicCss(array $settings): string {
    $css = '';
    if (isset($settings['primary_color'])) {
        $css .= ".layout-{$this->id} .button { background: {$settings['primary_color']}; }";
    }
    return $css;
}
```

### CSS Injection Flow
1. Determine current layout based on page context
2. Get settings for layout
3. Compile common CSS (cached)
4. Generate dynamic CSS from settings
5. Combine và inject vào wp_head
6. Track injected CSS để avoid duplicates

### Caching Strategy
- Compiled SCSS cached in transients
- Cache key includes file modification time
- Development mode (WP_DEBUG) bypasses cache
- Cache cleared khi settings thay đổi

## Tạo Layout mới

### Từ Theme
```php
// Extend abstract class phù hợp
class MyCustomLayout extends AbstractProductDetailLayout {
    public function __construct() {
        parent::__construct(
            'my-custom-layout',
            __('My Custom Layout'),
            'product-detail'
        );
        $this->supportedSettings = ['option1', 'option2'];
    }
    
    // Override methods nếu cần
    public function renderGallery(WC_Product $product): string {
        return '<div>Custom gallery</div>';
    }
}

// Đăng ký
add_action('jankx_woocommerce_register_layouts', function($manager) {
    $manager->register(new MyCustomLayout());
});
```

### SCSS File Structure
```scss
// assets/scss/layouts/{type}/{layout-id}.scss
.product-detail-my-custom-layout {
    .gallery { /* styles */ }
    .summary { /* styles */ }
    
    @media (max-width: 768px) { /* responsive */ }
}
```

## Settings Management

### Lưu và đọc settings
```php
$settings = SettingsManager::getInstance();

// Set single setting
$settings->set('layout-id.color', '#ff0000');

// Set multiple
$settings->setLayoutSettings('layout-id', [
    'color' => '#ff0000',
    'spacing' => 20
]);

// Get settings
$color = $settings->get('layout-id.color');
$all = $settings->getLayoutSettings('layout-id');
```

### Generate CSS from Settings
```php
// Tự động generate CSS từ settings
$css = $settings->generateCss('layout-id');

// Custom CSS generator
$settings->registerCssGenerator('product-detail', function($layoutId, $settings) {
    return ".layout { color: {$settings['color']}; }";
});
```

## Hooks và Filters

### Actions
- `jankx_woocommerce_register_default_layouts`: Đăng ký default layouts
- `jankx_woocommerce_register_layouts`: External registration từ themes/plugins
- `jankx_woocommerce_layout_registered`: After layout registered
- `jankx_woocommerce_default_layout_changed`: Default layout changed

### Filters
- `jankx_woocommerce_allow_layout_override`: Allow duplicate layout IDs
- `jankx_woocommerce_current_layout`: Override current layout
- `jankx_woocommerce_default_layout_id`: Override default layout ID
- `jankx_woocommerce_compiled_css`: Modify compiled CSS
- `jankx_woocommerce_scss_import_paths`: Add SCSS import paths
- `jankx_woocommerce_validate_layout_settings`: Custom validation

## API Usage Examples

### Get Layout Manager
```php
$manager = \Jankx\WooCommerce\LayoutSystem\LayoutManager::getInstance();

// Get layout
$layout = $manager->get('layout-id');

// Get by type
$detailLayouts = $manager->getByType('product-detail');

// Get default
$defaultLayout = $manager->getDefault('product-detail');

// Set default
$manager->setDefault('product-detail', 'my-layout-id');
```

### Inject Layout CSS
```php
$cssManager = \Jankx\WooCommerce\LayoutSystem\CssManager::getInstance();
$settings = ['color' => '#ff0000'];

// Inject layout CSS
$cssManager->injectLayoutCss($layout, $settings);

// Or manual
$css = $layout->getCommonCss() . $layout->getDynamicCss($settings);
$cssManager->inject($css, $layout->getId());
```

### Override Current Layout
```php
add_filter('jankx_woocommerce_current_layout', function($layout, $type) {
    if ($type === 'product-detail' && is_product(123)) {
        $manager = LayoutManager::getInstance();
        return $manager->get('special-layout');
    }
    return $layout;
}, 10, 2);
```

## Layout Types và Methods

### Product Detail Layout
Methods: renderGallery(), renderSummary(), renderMeta(), renderTabs(), renderRelatedProducts()
Settings: gallery_width, primary_color, show_related_products, sticky_add_to_cart

### Product Loop Layout
Methods: renderProduct(), renderThumbnail(), renderTitle(), renderPrice(), renderBadges(), renderQuickView()
Settings: columns, item_spacing, border_radius, show_quick_view, hover_effect

### Cart Page Layout
Methods: renderCartTable(), renderCartActions(), renderCrossSells(), renderCartCollaterals()
Settings: show_cross_sells, show_shipping_calculator, table_style

### Checkout Page Layout
Methods: renderBillingFields(), renderShippingFields(), renderOrderReview(), renderPaymentMethods()
Settings: layout_style (single/two-column/multi-step), field_spacing, button_color

## Performance Optimization

### CSS Strategy
- Inline CSS only (no external requests)
- SCSS compiled và cached
- Minified in production
- Only inject CSS for current page layout
- Avoid duplicate injections

### Caching
- Compiled CSS cached in transients
- Cache invalidation on settings change
- Development mode bypasses cache
- Cache keys include file modification time

### Best Practices
- Use SCSS variables và mixins
- Keep layouts focused (Single Responsibility)
- Validate settings before generating CSS
- Use lazy loading for heavy computations
- Minimize CSS output (only essential styles)

## Extension Points

Themes và plugins có thể:
1. Register custom layouts via `jankx_woocommerce_register_layouts`
2. Override default layouts via filters
3. Add custom settings cho layouts
4. Register custom CSS generators
5. Override templates trong theme directory
6. Add SCSS import paths
7. Hook vào lifecycle events

## Common Patterns

### Conditional Layout Loading
```php
add_filter('jankx_woocommerce_current_layout', function($layout, $type) {
    // Load different layout based on conditions
    if (user_is_premium()) {
        return $manager->get('premium-layout');
    }
    return $layout;
}, 10, 2);
```

### Custom Settings UI
```php
// Add settings fields trong theme customizer/options page
// Save to SettingsManager
$settings->setLayoutSettings($layoutId, $_POST['layout_settings']);
```

### A/B Testing Layouts
```php
add_filter('jankx_woocommerce_current_layout', function($layout, $type) {
    if ($type === 'product-detail') {
        $variant = get_ab_test_variant();
        return $manager->get("product-detail-variant-{$variant}");
    }
    return $layout;
}, 10, 2);
```

## Technical Details

### Dependencies
- WordPress 5.0+
- WooCommerce 4.0+
- PHP 7.4+
- scssphp/scssphp (SCSS compiler)

### File Locations
- Interfaces: includes/Contracts/
- Abstracts: includes/Abstracts/
- Managers: includes/LayoutSystem/
- Concrete layouts: includes/Layouts/
- SCSS: assets/scss/layouts/
- Templates: templates/layouts/

### Naming Conventions
- Layout IDs: kebab-case (e.g., 'grid-product-loop')
- Class names: PascalCase (e.g., GridProductLoopLayout)
- Methods: camelCase (e.g., renderProduct())
- Settings keys: snake_case (e.g., 'primary_color')

Đây là hệ thống layout hoàn chỉnh và production-ready cho WooCommerce với focus vào performance, extensibility và maintainability.

## Service Provider System

### WooCommerceLayoutServiceProvider
Quản lý configuration từ file và theme options với priority:
1. Theme Options (highest)
2. Config File
3. Defaults (lowest)

### Config File
Location: `themes/cheephub/config/woocomerce.php`

Structure:
```php
return [
    'product_detail' => [
        'default_layout' => 'layout-id',
        'enabled' => true,
        'settings' => [...],
    ],
    // ... 8 layout types total
    'global' => [...],
];
```

### Theme Options Integration
Auto-integration với:
- Redux Framework
- Titan Framework
- Kirki
- WordPress Theme Mods

Mapping example:
- Theme mod `woo_loop_columns` → `product_loop.settings.columns`
- Redux option `product_detail_gallery_width` → `product_detail.settings.gallery_width`

### API Usage
```php
$provider = \Jankx\WooCommerce\Providers\WooCommerceLayoutServiceProvider::getInstance();

// Get config
$value = $provider->get('product_detail.settings.gallery_width');
$config = $provider->getConfig();

// Update theme option
$provider->updateThemeOption('product_loop.settings.columns', 3);

// Reload
$provider->reload();
```

### Configuration Priority Flow
```
Load config file
    ↓
Load theme options (Redux/Titan/Kirki/Theme Mods)
    ↓
Deep merge (theme options override config)
    ↓
Apply to layouts via SettingsManager
    ↓
Generate dynamic CSS
```

### Auto-loading
Service Provider tự động khởi tạo qua LayoutBootstrap.
Config được load trong hook `after_setup_theme` (priority 15).
Settings được apply trong hook `jankx_woocommerce_register_layouts` (priority 100).

Xem SERVICE_PROVIDER.md để biết chi tiết về configuration system.
